```yaml
name: Copilot Setup Steps

permissions: {}

on:
  push:
    paths:
      - "src/**/*.rs"
      - "napi/**/*.rs"
      - "Cargo.toml"
      - "package.json"
      - "AGENTS.md"
      - ".github/workflows/copilot-setup-steps.yml"
  pull_request:
    types:
      - opened
      - synchronize
    paths:
      - "src/**/*.rs"
      - "napi/**/*.rs"
      - "Cargo.toml"
      - "package.json"
      - "AGENTS.md"
      - ".github/workflows/copilot-setup-steps.yml"

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  generate-context:
    name: Generate AI Context
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: taiki-e/checkout-action@b13d20b7cda4e2f325ef19895128f7ff735c0b3d # v1.3.1

      - uses: oxc-project/setup-rust@cd82e1efec7fef815e2c23d296756f31c7cdc03d # v1.0.0
        with:
          cache-key: copilot-setup
          save-cache: ${{ github.ref_name == 'main' }}
          tools: just
          components: rust-docs

      - uses: oxc-project/setup-node@8958a8e040102244b619c4a94fccb657a44b1c21 # v1.0.0

      - name: Install pnpm dependencies
        run: |
          pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
          cd fixtures/pnp && yarn
          cd fixtures/global-pnp && yarn
          cd fixtures/yarn && yarn

      - name: Generate Rust Documentation
        run: |
          mkdir -p docs/rust
          RUSTDOCFLAGS='-D warnings' cargo doc --no-deps --all-features --output docs/rust/doc
          echo "Rust documentation generated"

      - name: Extract TypeScript Definitions
        run: |
          mkdir -p docs/typescript
          cp napi/index.d.ts docs/typescript/
          echo "TypeScript definitions extracted"

      - name: Document Source File Structure
        run: |
          mkdir -p docs/structure
          find src -name "*.rs" -not -path "*/tests/*" | sort > docs/structure/source_files.txt
          find napi -name "*.rs" | sort > docs/structure/napi_files.txt
          echo "Source structure documented"

      - name: Extract Configuration Information
        run: |
          mkdir -p docs/config
          echo "=== Cargo.toml ===" > docs/config/cargo.toml
          head -20 Cargo.toml >> docs/config/cargo.toml
          echo "" >> docs/config/cargo.toml
          echo "=== package.json ===" >> docs/config/package.json
          head -20 package.json >> docs/config/package.json
          echo "Configuration information extracted"

      - name: Map Test Architecture
        run: |
          mkdir -p docs/tests
          find tests -name "*.rs" | sort > docs/tests/test_files.txt
          find napi/tests -name "*.mjs" | sort > docs/tests/napi_test_files.txt
          echo "Test architecture mapped"

      - name: Validate AGENTS.md Sections
        run: |
          if [ ! -f AGENTS.md ]; then
            echo "Error: AGENTS.md not found"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          # Check for required sections
          required_sections=("Project Overview" "Development Workflow" "Code Conventions" "Testing Strategy" "Common Patterns" "Performance Considerations" "Debugging")
          for section in "${required_sections[@]}"; do
            if ! grep -q "# $section" AGENTS.md; then
              echo "Missing required section: $section"
              exit 1
            fi
          done
          
          echo "AGENTS.md validation passed"

      - name: Create AI Context Bundle
        run: |
          tar -czf copilot-context.tar.gz docs/

      - name: Upload AI Context Bundle
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: copilot-context
          path: copilot-context.tar.gz
          retention-days: 1

      - name: Upload Rust Docs
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: rust-docs
          path: docs/rust/doc/
          retention-days: 1

      - name: Upload TypeScript Definitions
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: typescript-definitions
          path: docs/typescript/
          retention-days: 1

      - name: Upload Source Structure
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: source-structure
          path: docs/structure/
          retention-days: 1

      - name: Upload Configuration Info
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: configuration-info
          path: docs/config/
          retention-days: 1

      - name: Upload Test Info
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: test-info
          path: docs/tests/
          retention-days: 1
```
